checks_scope: real camera-basis A/D direction in first-person and Shoulder Surfing
real mouse steering direction with Shoulder Surfing
actual zero horizontal progress and zero chassis yaw on flat/snow/ice/water and blocked walls
S from rest reverse; forward S brake-stop-reverse; reverse W brake-stop-forward; W+S brake-only
reverse steering preserves wheel direction and reverses chassis curvature
actual submitted front-wheel axle projection compared to interpolated physical steering
raked headset seam-axis/body attachment, hub/triangle surface distances and actual grip targets
first-person downward full-turn left/right screenshot inspection

measurement_limits.server_control_latency: four-tick send interval plus one processing/sampling tick; exact earlier client wheel value required
measurement_limits.broad_render: actual submitted front-wheel axle normal compared with measured physical interpolation endpoints plus .24-degree pose quantization bound
measurement_limits.closeup_render: exact render partial-tick wheel compared to actual submitted front-wheel axle normal

visual_acceptance.result: fixed deck brace remains connected beneath rotating stem through both full A/D turns

observed_failures: A turned camera-right and D camera-left, including Shoulder Surfing
S stopped forward motion but did not drive in reverse
baseline_control.zero_motion_limit: settled truly stationary and fully blocked baseline samples did not reproduce sustained in-place yaw; transient phase carryover was corrected in the QA fixture, not claimed as product evidence
